'''Ogan-Dei''' was a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was one of the leader of the [[Strike Team Oricon]], a unit composed of members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] that were dispatched to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Oricon]] to eliminate the [[Dread Masters]].

Ogan-Dei was one of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] leaders to survive the initial approach to Oricon.

==Behind the scenes==
Ogan-Dei is a non-player character from the massively multi-player online role playing game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He is voiced by [[Fred Tatasciore]].
